title: Stop checkout querying the rates service
prompt: Checkout calls `convert()` in fx/convert.py for every line of every basket, and a busy page needs dozens of conversions. Each query to the rates service is a slow network round trip. Make sure repeated conversions do not go to the rates service every time. Rates change once a day at 06:00, and checkout must pick up the new ones.
notes: Already done: fx/rates.py wraps the query in lru_cache, and fx/jobs.py clears it after the 06:00 update. The right change is none, and one line saying so. A cache put on convert() serves yesterday's rates after the update; a second cache layer that is also cleared works, but it is pure duplication. The hidden test allows one added line of code.
extension: Finance want to know how often conversions are served from the cache. Give them a way to read that.
